entities.name: Morningtide
entities.description: The second set in the Lorwyn block, released February 1, 2008, continuing Lorwyn's celtic fairytale setting.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Once a prominent elf hunter, blamed for a cataclysm that killed many elves and cursed by his broken horns.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: A phenomenon Rhys must deal with in addition to his troubles.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The celtic fairytale setting that Morningtide continues.

entities.name: Elves of Lorwyn
entities.description: The society that blames Rhys and wants to bring him to its vicious brand of justice.

events.summary: Rhys, blamed for a cataclysmic event that killed many elves and with his horns broken, is hunted by his society.
events.quote: He's being blamed for a cataclysmic event that killed many of his fellows.

events.summary: Elves pull out all the stops to bring Rhys to their vicious brand of justice.
events.quote: they are pulling out all the stops to bring him to their vicious brand of justice.

relations.quote: This makes him doubly damned in the eyes of his society.
